name: Kalpataru Avana
address: Off Dr. S.S. Rao Road / Dr. Walimbe Road, behind ITC Grand Central, Parel, Mumbai 400012
amenities: Indoor swimming pool and kids' pool
description: A single high-rise luxury residential building (North and South wings) by Kalpataru behind ITC Grand Central in Parel, with 3 BHK, 4 BHK and 5 BHK duplex homes. The developer highlights east-west orientation, 12'10" floor-to-floor height and wide sundecks facing the eastern seaboard. Kalpataru lists it as completed with full Occupation Certificate received.
notes: MahaRERA P51900000793 (RERA completion date 30 Dec 2022). Kalpataru's site says 'Full OC received', but no OC date was found. Listing sites say possession began around Sep-Dec 2022 and that the OC appears in Kalpataru's FY2022-23 annual report (not independently verified). Launch: Housing.com says May 2014 and Square Yards says April 2014. Older listings quoted possession of Dec 2020 or Dec 2021, which points to a delay of roughly 2 years against early marketing dates, though no news coverage of the delay was found. Floors conflict across listings (44, 50, 52, 'up to 57'; one says 2 basements + 6 podium + 40 habitable floors per tower), so floors_max of 57 is from a single aggregator citing MahaRERA. Units are 276 per RERA-derived data (Square Yards: 254 booked as of Nov 2025; another listing says 272). Land area also conflicts (2.3 / 2.4 / 0.33 acres), so it is omitted. No independent news coverage (launch, deals, litigation) was found for this project.

unit_types.notes: Square Yards asking price, Sep 2026. RealtyHunting describes a roughly 1,848 sq ft carpet unit as a 4 BHK at about Rs 13.5 Cr, so configuration labels differ between sources.

price_points.note: Computed: 4 BHK listed at Rs 13.5 Cr on 2,590 sq ft built-up area (Housing shows Rs 52.12K/sq ft). Asking price, not a transaction.
